name: notebook
description: Notes, journal, and personal finance on iPhone and Mac.
author: Ramachandran Bakthavachalam

scripts.build:ios: xcodebuild -project ios/Notebook.xcodeproj -scheme Notebook -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -derivedDataPath build/ios CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.test:ios: xcodebuild -project ios/Notebook.xcodeproj -scheme Notebook -configuration Debug -destination "platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17 Pro" -derivedDataPath build/ios CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO ONLY_ACTIVE_ARCH=YES test
scripts.build:macos: xcodebuild -project ios/Notebook.xcodeproj -scheme NotebookMac -configuration Debug -derivedDataPath build/mac CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY=- CODE_SIGN_STYLE=Manual DEVELOPMENT_TEAM= build
scripts.check:swift-speed: xcodebuild -project ios/Notebook.xcodeproj -scheme NotebookMac -configuration Debug -derivedDataPath build/mac-speed CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY=- CODE_SIGN_STYLE=Manual DEVELOPMENT_TEAM= OTHER_SWIFT_FLAGS='$(inherited) -Xfrontend -warn-long-expression-type-checking=150 -Xfrontend -warn-long-function-bodies=600' build 2>&1 | grep -E '^/.*took [0-9]+ms to type-check' && echo 'Split these up: older Xcode versions give up on them.' && exit 1 || echo 'No slow Swift expressions.'
scripts.build:macos:signed: xcodebuild -project ios/Notebook.xcodeproj -scheme NotebookMac -configuration Debug -derivedDataPath build/mac-signed -allowProvisioningUpdates build
